title: KeySourceRouter — source selection, envelope blending, confidence, fallback
description:
Implement Source/DSP/KeySourceRouter as a real-time-safe key-path router (no allocations in process/processBlock paths).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md sections 4.1–4.3 (sources, envelope blending, confidence)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h key-source / externalBlend / fallbackMode IDs from phase A
- Source/PluginProcessor.* bus layout for main vs sidechain channel counts
- Existing Source/DSP/ conventions if present

Implement KeySourceRouter.h/.cpp:
- Source selection enum covering: main, external sidechain, blended main+external, left, right, stereo max, stereo average, mid, side.
- prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize, numMainChannels, numSidechainChannels) reset; process pointer/channel API that builds a mono key sample stream for the chosen source.
- Envelope blending for unrelated paths (default when blending main+external envelopes):
  E_K[n] = (1 - mu) * E_I[n] + mu * E_E[n], mu in [0,1] from externalBlend.
- Source confidence / status flags the UI will consume: externalPresent, externalSilent, channelMismatch, lowConfidence, internalFallbackActive, alignmentNotCalibrated.
- Never silently treat a missing or empty sidechain as a valid external key: when external is selected/required but unavailable, apply configured fallbackMode to internal main and raise internalFallbackActive (and lowConfidence as appropriate).
- Keep all DSP real-time safe (no heap alloc, no locks, no logging on audio thread).

Do NOT edit CMakeLists.txt (b.3 owns it). Do NOT implement KeyConditioner, PowerlineShield, or DetectorEngine.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: KeySourceRouter supports main, external, blended main+external, left, right, stereo max, stereo average, mid, and side source modes
KeySourceRouter implements envelope blend E_K = (1-mu)*E_I + mu*E_E with mu in [0,1]
KeySourceRouter exposes confidence/status flags including external present/silent, channel mismatch, low confidence, and internal fallback active
Missing or silent sidechain never silently counts as a valid external key; fallback to internal is explicit via flags/mode
No heap allocation in the per-block process path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: use plain C++20 + JUCE types already in the project
define key source and fallback enums/structs in the KeySourceRouter headers
compute simple per-block or per-sample internal/external envelopes for blending only
forbidden: implement hum notches or peak/RMS detector ballistics here
